journeys.startingState: A locally bootstrapped repository with the web app available.
expectedBehavior: The page shows the seven named sections and the 60-minute session timing.
preservedInvariants: The displayed running order comes from the domain section catalogue.
journeys.oracle: The rendered page contains all seven section titles, seven durations, and the 60-minute session summary without a fatal runtime error.
nonClaims: Local proof does not establish a deployed provider route.

journeys.boundary: Browser room adapter and Cloudflare Room Worker
journeys.startingState: The deployed app has VITE_ROOM_API_URL configured for the live Room Worker.
expectedBehavior: The host can control the room and the player/display views receive the same serialisable state.
expectedSideEffects: The named development room Durable Object stores the serialisable room state.
preservedInvariants: Every transition is accepted or rejected by the shared pure room reducer.
journeys.oracle: The three views show matching room status, current section, joined team, and score after each action; invalid room codes fail closed.
nonClaims: The development-stage journey does not establish production behaviour.

journeys.startingState: The domain and HTTP API packages are available in-process.

preservedInvariants: Unknown ingress decodes at the HTTP boundary.
journeys.oracle: The response passes the owning encoded response Schema and an invalid section identifier fails closed.
nonClaims: In-process transport proof does not establish a deployed public route.
